name: silo-harness
description: An open-source agent harness for macOS, in the style of Claude Code: local models via Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible provider, sessions that run side by side, and mods.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && mkdir -p dist/renderer/vendor && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/*.css dist/renderer/ && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/lib/xterm.js node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.js node_modules/@xterm/addon-web-links/lib/addon-web-links.js dist/renderer/vendor/

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Silo Harness works in the folder you choose. Its default folder, Silo, is in Documents.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: A session or a command in Silo Harness is working with files on your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: A session or a command in Silo Harness is working with files in Downloads.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: A session or a command in Silo Harness is working with files on a removable disk.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: A session or a command in Silo Harness is working with files on a network disk.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Reaches what you set up on your own network: a model server, an MCP server, a local page, or your phone for remote control.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: A command run in Silo Harness wants to control another app.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: A page you allowed, or a command, asked for the camera. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: A page you allowed, or a command, asked for the microphone. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: A page you allowed, or a command, asked to record audio. Silo Harness itself never does.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: A page you allowed in the Browser pane asked for your location. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
extendInfo.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: A page you allowed in the Browser pane asked for your location. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: A command run in Silo Harness asked for Bluetooth. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: A command run in Silo Harness asked for Bluetooth. Silo Harness itself never uses it.
